steps: Open a new Better Than Free checking account at a First U.S. branch, online, or by phone using promo code BTF300.
Set up a qualifying direct deposit of $500 or more into the new account so it posts within 90 days of opening (payroll/ACH only — not Zelle, Venmo, or debit-card credits).
Wait up to 4 weeks after First U.S. verifies the direct deposit; the $300 bonus is deposited into the new checking account.
